I have seen the great horned owl, its wings wide and powerful, stretching out across the moonlit sky. I have heard the creak of the ancient tree, the rustle of the night-bird, the flutter of the feathered creatures. The world is still, yet in this moment, I feel a sense of peace and clarity.
